title: Venezuelan Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Venezuela, made with lentils, vegetables, and aromatic spices. This dish is perfect for a cozy dinner with family and friends.

ingredients.name: jubilant lentils
ingredients.notes: brown or green lentils work well

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion, bell pepper, and carrot. Cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add cumin and paprika. Cook for 1 minute.
Add lentils, veggie broth, and rice. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
